findings.summary: The rig recorded win=true on a LOSS: sim-results.json 'win' means only 'a result overlay appeared', and the star-racer lose overlay 'TRY AGAIN — Shot down in the trench' at t=42.7s was flagged by verdictNote but still stored as win, so win-counting aggregations will misreport this level.

ArrowUp descends: climb = -1 on input.up() drives playerY to -0.95 which the projection paints at the trench floor (py = H-70-(playerY+1)*78), while the controls copy says '↑ ↓ / W S fly high-low' — pressing ↑ reads as ascend to a booth player but sends the shuttle down.

The blind keyboard driver can never reach the win path: the driver spec has no X and no SPACE, the genre needs X to harvest energy (5 required to arm the torpedo, only the y=-0.55 altitude cells are reachable while floor-hugging → 3/5) and SPACE to fire at the port; the driver reached ~95% of the trench with the Death Star port dead ahead and died to a turret blob at 0:40.

Genre debug state was not captured: window.__SR exposes read() only (no state()), so the rig probe's JSON.stringify yields {} on every trace row — the genre's own debug telemetry is an evidence dead-end.

Edge coverage (pause at 70% / blur / refocus / mash) was never exercised — the run ended on the lose overlay at t=42.7s, long before the 168s edge phase, so star-racer's pause-survival is unverified here.
Same two boot 404s as the other levels for the missing assets/logo-all.svg and assets/logo-in.svg (title-screen brand images), filtered by BOOTH_FILTER but present in the console log.

No audio control exists during play (mute button is title-screen-only, pause overlay has no sound toggles) and headless video carries no audio track, so music 'space' / crash-hit SFX are unverifiable from this evidence.
